name: Date Range Simplify
description: Field formatters (and Twig helpers) that render daterange/datetime fields as simplified, locale-aware date phrases via the flack/ranger library.
project_description:
Provides field formatters to simplify daterange field output, collapsing the shared parts of a start/end range into a compact phrase such as "October 5, 2013, 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM". A companion Intl formatter renders single date/datetime fields, and a Twig extension exposes the same formatting to templates.

The formatters wrap https://github.com/flack/ranger (based on the range formatter in fullCalendar) to offer a simplified set of output options outside of Drupal's standard date-format configuration. Date and time styles are the ones enumerated by the PHP IntlDateFormatter class: NONE, FULL, LONG, MEDIUM and SHORT. For non-'en' locales the PHP php-intl extension is required. See https://github.com/flack/ranger/blob/master/README.md for details. Similar module: Daterange Compact.
